findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and cleaned.
findings.comment: The caulking on the three compartment sink was observed to be coming off. PIC was made aware. Ensure that the three compartment sink is caulked providing a smooth and easily cleanable surface.
findings.citation_text: 6-101.11(A)(1) Surface Characteristics. (A) Except as specified in (B) of this section, materials for indoor floor, wall, and ceiling surfaces under conditions of normal use shall be: (1) SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE for areas where FOOD ESTABLISHMENT operations are conducted.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The hood system is observed to have an accumulation of dust of its internal surfaces. Ensure the hood system is cleaned to remove the current accumulation of dust and then cleaned at a freqeuncy necessary to maintain it clean.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-101.11: The wall above the triple sink is observed to have blue anchors in the wall which has exposed holes to the interior of the wall. These anchors need to be removed from the wall and caulking or another form of repair needs to be made to create a smooth, nonabsorbent, and easily cleanable surface.
6-101.11: (A) Materials indoor shall be SMOOTH, durable, and EASILY CLEANABLE. Areas subject to moisture must be Nonabsorbent. (B) In TEMPORARY FOOD ESTABLISHMENT, floor may be material effectively treated to control dust and mud. Walls and ceilings may be material that protects interior from weather and windblown dust and debris.

findings.title: Food-contact surfaces; cleaned and sanitized
findings.comment:
4-501.114: The dish machine was tested 8 times utilizing the appropriate chlorine test strips and was recorded at a maximum of 10ppm chlorine solution in the sanitizer. A service call is being placed to have the dish machine repaired. Ensure test strips are used daily to observe the correct operation of the dish machine at the correct sanitizer concentration.
4-501.114: Chemical sanitizer for manual or mechanical operation shall meet proper criteria: (A) chlorine shall have minimum temperature (55F), concentration (100ppm), and pH (10). (B) Iodine shall have 68F, pH of 5 or less and concentration of 12.5ppm and 25ppm. (C) Quaternary ammonium shall have 75F, concentration based on label, and water with 500ppm hardness or less. (D) - (E) Meets EPA-label use and regulatory authority approval. (P) (F) Other chemical sanitzers in-use shall have EPA-registered label, display device registration number on devide and is operated and maintained in accordance with manufacturers instructions (Pf)

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment:
4-601.11: The sides of the cooler i the facility are observed with an accumulation of dust/debris. This piece of equipment needs to be pulled out and have its external surfaces cleaned and sanitized and then cleaned and sanitized at a frequency necessary to prevent the accumulation of dust/debris.
4-601.11: (B) The FOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of cooking EQUIPMENT and pans shall be kept free of encrusted grease deposits and other soil accumulations. (C) NonFOOD-CONTACT SURFACES of EQUIPMENT shall be kept free of an accumulation of dust, dirt, FOOD residue, and other debris.

findings.title: Proper cold holding temperatures
findings.comment:
3-501.16: Facility cooler is observed to be operating between 49-53 degrees F. Facility PIC observed the cooler operating at 39 degrees F at 7:30am. Butter was probed and recorded at 46 degrees F at 9:15am. Facility is to contact AirMasters and have them service the equipment to allow it to operate at or below 41 degrees F. Facility shall monitor the equipment and if the temperature continues to hover in the higher temperature range for 4 hours (1:00pm) the food items within the cooler will have to be discarded. The food items within the cooler are to be moved into an operational unit that is able to hold foods below 41 degrees F until the unit can receive maintenance. 
3-501.16: (A) (2) TCS FOOD shall be maintained at 41F or less. (B) EGGS not treated to destroy Salmonellae shall be stored at 45F or less.

findings.title: Food in good condition, safe, and unadulterated
findings.comment:
3-202.15: There were two observed cans that were excessively dented in the dry storage. These cans were removed from service and are being returned to the supplier. Ensure all food items are inspected and returned if damaged to allow the quality and safety of the food items to remain intact. 
3-202.15: FOOD packages shall be in good condition and protect the integrity of the contents so that the FOOD is not exposed to ADULTERATION or potential contaminants.

findings.title: Physical facilities installed, maintained, and clean
findings.comment:
6-501.11: There is an observed hole in the wall under the triple sink that appears to have a cord and an accumulation of dust present. Ensure that a plate or covering is placed over this opening to prevent any potential issues from arising.
6-501.11: PHYSICAL FACILITIES shall be maintained in good repair.

findings.title: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible
findings.comment:
6-301.12 Paper towel dispenser was empty in the restroom. Paper towel dispenser was refilled during the inspection. 
Each handwashing sink shall be provided with Individual, disposable towels or another approved drying option.
findings.citation_text:
6-301.14 Handwashing signage was not posted in the employee restroom. A handwashing informational sheet was posted inside the cabinet above the kitchen handsink but was not visibly posted at the handsink. Handwashing signage was provided and posted in both locations. 
A sign or poster that notifies food employees to wash their hands shall be provided at all handwashing sinks used by food employees and shall be clearly visible to food employees.

findings.title: Warewashing facilities: installed, maintained, & used; test strips
findings.comment: REPEAT> No quaternary ammonium test strips are available for testing of the ready to use quaternary ammonium sanitizer in the spray bottle. A few strips were left with the facility and this has been added to their order for Wednesday.
findings.citation_text: 4-302.14  (Pf) Test kits or other devices are not available to the employees to measure sanitizing solution concentration. Provide a test kit or other measuring device so the employees can measure concentrations and ensure proper sanitization. Avoid a concentration of sanitizer that is too high, which can be toxic. Reference 4-302.14.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
No quaternary ammonium test strips are available for testing the concentration of the ready to use quaternary ammonium sanitizer in the spray bottle. Provide quaternary ammonium test strips for testing this sanitizer.
750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.comment:
Dish machine tested at 0 ppm chlorine initially. Sanitizer bottle was changed out and machine was primed and subsequently tested at 50 ppm chlorine on the third run. Test machine daily to ensure it is testing at 50 ppm chlorine for effective sanitizing.
750-830 All chemical sanitizers in a dish machine must meet the requirements of 21 CFR 178.1010 to ensure all items are properly sanitized.  Rinse water shall not less than 75F. Provide proper sanitizer concentration.

findings.title: Sanitizing concentration
findings.citation_text: 750.830 Dish machine is reading 0ppm Cl. Machine was primed and re-ran and still tested at 0ppm. Facility contacted dish machine operator. Facility will use 3 compartment sink to wash dishes until dish machine in fixed.

findings.title: Thermometers, gauges, test kits provided
findings.comment:
There was no quaternary ammonia test kit for the spray sanitizer used on food prep counter tops and other work surfaces.   Obtain a test kit that will work with quaternary ammonia sanitizer (quat).

750-830g A test kit shall be provided and used for checking the concentration of chemical sanitizer that measures the concentration of solution in parts per million.

findings.title: Plumbing installed and maintained
findings.comment:
The faucet at the 3 compartment sink leaks when turned on.  Repair the leak.

750-1060 All plumbing shall be sized, installed, and maintained in accordance with applicable provisions of the Illinois State Plumbing Code. Repair fixtures in accordance with the Illinois Plumbing Code.

findings.title: Non-food contact surfaces clean
findings.comment: 750.800e - The following non-food contact surfaces were soiled: A) shelves in cooler (buildup); B) spice storage cabinet (food debris); & C) hood/filters (dust buildup). Clean the above items and all non-food contact surfaces daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of accumulation of dust, dirt, food particles, and other debris.

findings.title: Floors properly constructed, clean, drained
findings.citation_text: 750.1220 - Floor drain for 3 part sink had some grease/food debris buildup in it. Clean the floor drains daily/as needed to eliminate buildup of debris.
